business_definition: Number of distinct companies with active status.
aggregation_logic: COUNT(DISTINCT company_ID) FROM mt_safe_company WHERE company_status_simple = 'ACTIVE'

business_definition: Total number of certificates earned in a given period (mandatory + elective).
aggregation_logic: COUNT(*) GROUP BY time period, certificate_type
notes: IMPORTANT: mt_safe_certificate has ONLY Wahlzertifikat. For Pflichtzertifikat, use mt_safe_user WHERE certificate_type IS NOT NULL. For all cert types, use mt_safe_user.

business_definition: Percentage of course assignments completed on or before the deadline.
denominator: COUNT(*) WHERE completedOn IS NOT NULL AND deadline_assignment IS NOT NULL
aggregation_logic: Join mt_safe_certificate ON assignmentId = mt_safe_assignment.assignment_ID, then compare completedOn vs deadline_assignment
notes: Deadline compliance: On Time = completedOn <= deadline. Late = completedOn > deadline. Not Completed = completedOn IS NULL and deadline IS NOT NULL.

business_definition: Percentage of attempted exams that were passed.
aggregation_logic: COUNT(CASE WHEN hasPassed THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) FROM mt_safe_exam_result
notes: For company-level pass rate, join exam_result → assignment_course_progress → assignment → company.

business_definition: Average exam result percentage across attempts.
denominator: COUNT(*) exam attempts with non-null resultPercentage
notes: New metric derived from available data. Not in original gold metrics.

business_definition: Percentage of closed opportunities that were won.
aggregation_logic: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_won THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN is_closed THEN 1 END) FROM mt_safe_opportunity
supported_dimensions: stage_name, opportunity_type, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, platform, vertical
notes: New metric from Salesforce opportunity data.

business_definition: Average opportunity amount for closed-won deals.
aggregation_logic: AVG(amount) FROM mt_safe_opportunity WHERE is_won = true

business_definition: Ratio of actual users to licensed user slots per company.
numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) per company (from mt_safe_assignment_course_progress joined to mt_safe_assignment for company_ID1)
aggregation_logic: Requires joining user counts per company with contract license counts
notes: New metric. Proxy: count distinct users per company / noOfLicenses.

business_definition: Ratio of completed course assignments to total assignments for a company.
denominator: COUNT(*) total records per company (join to mt_safe_assignment for company_ID1)
aggregation_logic: Join mt_safe_assignment_course_progress with mt_safe_assignment on assignment_id1. COUNT WHERE user_course_state = 'COMPLETED' / total per company.
notes: user_course_state values are uppercase: COMPLETED, NOTSTARTED, INPROGRESS, FINISHEDWATCHING
